title: [feature request] Allow changing night light temperature with global shortcuts
line: New global shortcuts raise or lower the Night Light temperature by 100 K and show the new value in an on-screen display.
explanation: KWin's Night Light only had the global shortcut to suspend and resume it, so changing the night temperature meant opening System Settings each time. The change adds two global shortcuts in the Window Management (KWin) group, "Increase Night Light Temperature" and "Decrease Night Light Temperature", with no default keys. Each press moves the night temperature setting by 100 K (clamped to 1000-6500 K), saves it to kwinrc like the System Settings page does, applies it, and shows "Night Light Temperature: 4,300 K" in the Plasma OSD.

commits.message:
plugins/nightlight: add shortcuts to change the night temperature

Changing the Night Light temperature meant opening System Settings every
time. Add "Increase" and "Decrease Night Light Temperature" global
shortcuts that move the night temperature by 100 K and show it in an OSD.

BUG: 515832

media.caption: Master: the only Night Light global shortcut KWin registers is Toggle Night Color (Suspend/Resume).
With the fix: Increase/Decrease Night Light Temperature are registered; three presses of Decrease take 4500 K to 4200 K and the OSD shows it.
Increase moves it back up by 100 K, with the same OSD.

review.text: Two unbound KWin global shortcuts change the persisted night temperature by the KCM's 100 K step, clamped to the valid range, and reuse the same osdService text OSD Night Light already uses for Suspend/Resume. Writing the setting keeps System Settings in sync. A small, self-contained feature that follows the existing toggle action's pattern.
